findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: build_application_checklist, check_policy_readiness, start_application · Private data: match_merchant_account, check_dispute_ratio, build_application_checklist, check_policy_readiness, start_application · Public sink: match_merchant_account, build_shutdown_checklist, check_dispute_ratio, build_application_checklist, start_application_handoff, compare_processor_fit, start_application.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: build_application_checklist, check_policy_readiness, start_application · Private data: match_merchant_account, check_dispute_ratio, build_application_checklist, check_policy_readiness, start_application · Public sink: match_merchant_account, build_shutdown_checklist, check_dispute_ratio, build_application_checklist, start_application_handoff, compare_processor_fit, start_application

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
